## Login
Client-side only, no server auth. `AuthService` (`frontend/src/app/services/auth.service.ts`) handles it:
- `login(username)` looks up `localStorage` key `ai_dnd_user_<username.toLowerCase()>`; if found, loads that `UserProfile`, else creates a fresh `{ username, campaigns: [] }` and persists it.
- Profile also mirrored under key `ai_dnd_user` (current-session pointer).
- `authGuard` (`auth.guard.ts`) blocks routes via `auth.isLoggedIn()` (checks profile !== null), redirecting to `/login`.
- `LoginComponent.login()` calls `auth.login()`, then routes to `/characters` (new) or shows existing campaign slots.

## Campaign storage
Campaigns are stored **only in the browser**, as `CampaignSlot[]` inside the `UserProfile` object in `localStorage` (same keys as above). Each `CampaignSlot` (`game.models.ts`) holds `slotId, characterName, characterClass, characterRace, level, sessionId, characterId, lastPlayed, location`.

Server-side game state lives separately: Cloudflare KV (`session:<sessionId>`, 7-day TTL, via `worker/src/services/session.ts`) and D1 (`adventure_log`, character table — `worker/src/services/character.ts`).

## Deleting a campaign slot
`AuthService.removeCampaign(slotId)` just filters the slot out of the local `campaigns` array and re-persists the profile to `localStorage`. **It does not call any backend API** — the corresponding `characterId`/`sessionId` record in D1 and the KV session blob are not deleted or touched; the character persists server-side as an orphaned record, just no longer referenced by the user's local profile.
